published_source: SCRAMBLED (synthetic-equivalent) DATA. The package README states the shipped files are a 20% sample of establishments with quarter, quarter_added, county, lntot_rec, county_quarter and relquarter shuffled across rows (Stata shufflevar) and that 'our results do not replicate using this scrambled data'. The shuffling destroys the panel: 16,805 duplicate locid-quarter rows, quarter_added varies within locid for 2,051 of 2,059 establishments, and treat_q no longer equals 1{quarter >= quarter_added}. No article text in the project; the paper's coefficients are unknown (abstract: revenue increase 'in the range of 5%-10%'). Published coefficient fields are therefore null. Numbers here carry no information about the paper and must be excluded from the main analysis.

event_structure.source: scripts/figure_2a.R lines 20-30: relquarter (quarters since added to Yelp; NA -> 999 for never-listed), did2s first stage ~ 0 | locid + county_quarter on untreated rows (treat_q = 0), second stage ~ i(relquarter, ref = c(-1, 999)) with an intercept (article eq. in Section 3.3.2: Y~ = alpha + sum_z beta_z 1(z)); unbinned single-quarter dummies over the full range, plotted -8..8 (Figure 2(a)(i)). In the real data relquarter = quarter - quarter_added and quarters 188-231 (2007q1-2017q4) are consecutive, so relquarter = rel = t - g in the pipeline index. Bins: every relative time possible in the 44-quarter panel (-43..43, -1 omitted; the real data span -43..41 because adoption starts in 190, so bins 42-43 are empty there), never-listed units in the reference with all indicators zero; nothing is uncovered. Summaries = the plotted window (post 0..8, pre -8..-2).
event_structure.verified: Coding identity only (scrambled data): with g := quarter - relquarter row by row on the shipped file (authors' preprocessing), did2s with indicators from es_assign reproduces all 83 coefficients and SEs of the authors' figure_2a.R did2s event study exactly (max abs diff 0; post mean 0..8 = 0.00604, pre mean -8..-2 = -0.00825, as in prepare_and_verify.log). The published Figure 2(a) values are not reproducible (README: results do not replicate on the scrambled data), and the pipeline's treat_q-based rel differs from the shuffled relquarter. scratchpad/meta3/mnsc.2024.04716/verify.R/.log

replication_status: failed (scrambled package data; README: results do not replicate; article coefficients unknown)
notes: scripts/figure_2a.R line 27: did2s event study, second stage i(relquarter, ref = c(-1, 999)), FE locid + county_quarter, cluster locid; unbinned relquarter dummies over the full range, plotted -8..8. run_spec.R event mode bins endpoints at -9/+9 and averages rel 0..8 (post) and -8..-2 (pre). relquarter itself is shuffled in the shipped file, so run_spec.R uses rel = quarter - g with g derived from treat_q. Authors' estimator is Gardner did2s with treatment = treat_q (1 if listed on Yelp in the quarter), second stage i(treat_q, ref=0), cluster locid; TWFE counterpart feols(lntot_rec ~ treat_q | FE). run_spec.R derives g = first quarter with treat_q = 1 per locid and drops later rows with treat_q = 0 (switch-offs), which in the scrambled file are numerous because quarter is shuffled; the regression sample therefore differs from the authors' all-rows sample. Work file = shipped fullsample_for_r_sample.dta with treat_q non-missing, quarter_added0 (NA->0) and post_yelp added; package untouched. NOV 2 AUDIT: event_structure added (authors' unbinned relquarter dummies, reference -1 plus never-listed). The article text is now in the project (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2024.04716.txt; Figure 2(a)(i) is graphical only), but the data remain scrambled, so the spec stays excluded (data_provenance synthetic) and published_coef stays null. No adoption_var: the real data have no pre-sample adopters (first adoption quarter 190 > first quarter 188), and the shuffled quarter_added cannot identify adoption dates in the shipped file.
